ctx.x: So Xavier Cugat (unintelligible). We go to this dance and he plays the first set (unintelligible). People are going to be crazy. So when we got through, he say, -- it was an ironical way to say, , we play the music, I have collected a bunch. (Unintelligible.) Like you've got 50 cents and I've got a million dollars. (Unintelligible) I collect and you get nothing.
But those are the kind of things you have to face.
